role: Historical software reference on complete new continuous development; no model selection or candidate acceptance
policy: Every source in original reservation order, one reset at each whole call boundary, complete continuously computed native frontend arrays, no additional prime or gaps. This follows existing full-background reset semantics; not the application-zero-prime positive diagnostic. Two exact raw-score replays per complete call. Firmware double sum/divide five scores, threshold float32 historical .91796875, rearm half-threshold and >=67steps; retain separate host convolution events/differences.
timestamps: One-based raw score step s has native feature-availability source endpoint (3*(s-1)+5)*160 samples. This is neither application480-sample return quantization nor wall-clock hardware/acoustic latency.
denominator: Sum original complete decoded source samples /16000 /3600, excludes final frontend zero-pad samples. All events count, including first model warm-up/last padded chunk; no subset, event suppression or source deletion. Starts have natural frontend/model warm-up; no extra exposure is invented.
score_policy: Historical v30 only; no current formal checkpoint, candidate or final set. No threshold grid/calibration/source or event filtering. Future Hi ESP requires byte-pinned engine and exact samePCM verification. Any future survivor requires a separate historical-threshold profile after passing old gates; do not use this cohort to rescue an old gate failure.
publication: Only model score arrays, small reports/provenance/source code may be handed off; no source/decoded audio or frontend-array payloads.
limits: Twelve complete recording clusters and company-country metadata do not prove speaker/pretraining independence or126independent people. Financial-call exposure is domain limited.
